name: Prokhorovka - Hill 252.2 Sector
historical_basis: Prokhorovka, 12 July 1943: Hill 252.2, Oktyabrskiy State Farm, the Psel corridor, anti-tank ditch, and railway embankment.
design_notes: open steppe tank map, rebuilt on its historical skeleton: the east-west railway embankment divides the sectors, the naked Psel flank runs west, Hill 252.2 rules the east - and the steppe is now CUT the way the real one is, by drawn balkas

three lanes, three characters: the bare Psel field (fast and punished), the Oktyabrskiy farm corridor on its bench (the brawl), and the hill duel with TWO hull-down systems per side - the west-facing crest shelf against pushes from the centre, and the axis-facing top ridge for the north-south standoff

the anti-tank ditch is a meandering balka ~110 m before the axis: the covered east-west rotation of each half - masked from the embankment line, still overlooked from the hill top; the Storozhevoe draw gives a masked approach into the east lane
1000m x 1000m at 5m height samples; mirror-symmetric across the central embankment axis so both teams get equivalent ground
